_comment: Per-source rate gates, daily budgets and cost tables. All numbers are estimates to reconcile with provider dashboards (docs/UNVERIFIED.md). rate_per_s * burst = token bucket. daily_cost 'env:RPC_DAILY_BUDGET_CU' is replaced by the env value. Milestone 4: the rpc table follows the published Alchemy compute-unit page as read on 26 Oct 2026; websocket frames (byte_priced methods) are booked as bytes x cu_per_byte, the ledger keeps the bytes.

rpc._comment: getTransaction 40, getSignaturesForAddress 40, getTokenLargestAccounts 20, getAccountInfo 10: the Alchemy compute-unit page (https://www.alchemy.com/docs/reference/compute-unit-costs, read 26 Oct 2026). getSlot, getBlockTime, getMultipleAccounts were not read from the page and stay estimates. Solana websocket subscriptions are billed per byte: 0.0002 CU per byte according to the Solana section of that page; its 'Webhooks and Subscription APIs' section says 0.04 CU per byte (a factor 200, not reconciled). cu_per_byte 0.0002 is the working value until the dashboard comparison in docs/UNVERIFIED.md settles it; set 0.04 to book the pessimistic reading. ws_notification/ws_subscribe = the creates+migrations log stream (rpc_logs), ws_trade_* = the per-mint trade stream (rpc_trades), booked separately so `fart status` -> rpc CU today by method shows bytes and CU per stream. ws_connect stays a flat estimate.

pumpportal._comment: connect gate: max 12 connects per hour, one connection at a time

dexscreener._comment: official limit 300/min for token endpoints; we self-limit to 100/min

x._comment: X API v2 pay-per-use. cost = estimated USD per call (config/x.json prices); daily_cost is the hard USD cap from X_DAILY_BUDGET_USD. The hourly envelope, the 30% account-watch reserve and the KOL sub-cap live in fart/social/x.py (XBudget) and are ledgered in x_spend.

telegram._comment: Bot API sendMessage to the owner chat: max 20 messages per minute; 429 retry_after is honored.
